metadata.name: touch.press
metadata.description: button pointerdown (dispatch): synthesize a keydown for <key> through keys.capture (so keys.pressed/routing behave as for a real key)

metadata.name: touch.release
metadata.description: button pointerup/cancel (dispatch): synthesize a keyup for <key> through keys.capture

metadata.name: touchpad
metadata.description: (keys) - an on-screen overlay of hold-buttons; keys=[{label,key}] write keys.pressed via touch.press/release. Doom cannot tell a thumb from a keyboard.

metadata.name: touchcapable
metadata.description: () - true on a touch device (maxTouchPoints>0 / ontouchstart). Mount the overlay only when capable.
